_about: Nova's scripted lines (new-flow prompt §5, §7, §8c). Every line is spoken AND shown. 'lead' parts contain {name} and are voiced live by our LOCAL server only (never pre-rendered, never sent to a third party); the rest is pre-rendered to /audio/nova/<id>.mp3 by scripts/nova-voices.mjs. type: imagine = Nova's own words, fact = must cite sourceIds.

lines.text: Welcome to Space Archaeologist! I'm Nova. Ready to discover the machines explorers left on the Moon and Mars? Click Start!
I'm Nova, your space guide on Starship Odyssey!
How are you today?
Yay! That makes me happy too!
Okay is okay! Exploring space might make it great.
Thanks for telling me. We'll take it nice and easy today.
Thanks for telling me!
Are you ready to learn about real space missions?
Awesome! Here's how it works.
Click a mission on the wall to learn and discover what happened there.
Each mission starts with a real NASA video. Then you help launch the rocket and watch the story.
After the story, you can play a mini-game. You'll use your hands in front of the camera, or the mouse if you like.
And you can ask me anything about NASA and space missions, anytime! Just press this button and talk, or type your question.
Let's start with the Moon. Ready? Click it!
Which mission do you want to explore today?
You finished the Moon mission! ⭐ Mars is waiting when you're ready.
You finished the Mars mission! ⭐ The Moon is waiting when you're ready.

lines.lead: You've finished all the open missions, {name}!
lines.text: More are coming soon. You can replay any mission or ask me questions.
Start the Moon mission?
Start the Mars mission?
That mission is still sealed. It's coming soon!
Here we go! Buckle up!
Woohoo! I loved it too!
Thanks for being honest! Every explorer has different favourites.
Thanks for sharing that with me!
Did you learn something today?
Great job! Here's one more fun fact.
That's how all learning starts! Here's one fun fact.
Scientists still bounce lasers off the reflector they left behind.
It was planned for 90 Martian days. It worked about 60 times longer!
Do you have any questions about the mission?
Ask me anything about the mission! Talk or type.
Any other questions?
Are you ready for a mini-game?
Okay! Let's watch the story again.
What would you like to know about NASA and space?
I'm listening!
I'm not sure about that one. You could look it up on nasa.gov with a grown-up!
I don't know that one yet! Try asking me about the Moon landing or the Mars rover.
Hmm, my radio is a bit slow right now. Try asking me again in a moment!
Let's rest the radio for a little bit. Explore a mission, then ask me again!
One question at a time, space explorer!
Hi! I'm Nova. Welcome aboard, Space Archaeologist!
Long ago, brave machines flew to the Moon and to Mars.
Many of them are still there, quiet and waiting.
Your job: find them, dust them off and learn their true stories.
Keep your finds in your Passport, earn badges, and ask me anything!
Ready? Pick a mission on our ship. Let's go!
Oops, my space ears got fuzzy. Can you say that again?
I didn't catch that. Try again, or type your question!
That sounds really important. Please tell a grown-up you trust, like a parent or teacher, right away.
I'm here to talk about space with you whenever you want.
I'm your NASA space guide, so I only talk about space missions! Want to know why the Moon has no wind?
lines.chip: Why is there no wind on the Moon?

lines.text: That's not a space question, but here's a fun one. Want to hear about the Martian blueberries?
I only know about NASA and space. Ask me about the Apollo 11 Moon landing!
Let's keep our eyes on the stars! You could ask me how Opportunity got its power.
That one's outside my space suit! Want to know what the astronauts left on the Moon?
lines.chip: What did they leave on the Moon?

lines.text: I'm just here for space adventures. Ask me how long the trip to Mars took!
lines.chip: How long was the trip to Mars?

lines.text: How do you want to talk with me?
I need to hear you through the microphone. A grown-up can help you say yes!
Yay! Tap me anytime to start talking!
Great! Tap me anytime, and we can type to chat.
No problem! Let's type instead.
We visit brave machines that went quiet, and hear their stories!
This is the Mission Wall. Missions 1 and 2 are open. More unlock soon!
Pick a mission. Then pull the launch lever down to blast off!
True story means it really happened. Imagine means a pretend part of the story.
Ask me space questions with this button. Finish missions to earn passport stamps!
Settings live up here. Press Replay anytime to hear me again!
You're ready, explorer! Let's start with the Moon.
Hi, explorer! Ask me anything about space missions!
I'm super, thanks for asking! Want to hear about the Moon or Mars?
I'm Nova, your space guide! What space question do you have?
You're welcome! Got another space question for me?
Bye for now, explorer! The stars will be waiting.
That's not a space question! Want to know about the Moon or Mars?
Open Ship stations to visit your Space Archive shelf.
Mission Records keeps your investigations and pinned evidence.
The wardrobe lets you change your explorer anytime.
Your star chart celebrates points, badges, and completed missions.
